questions.prompt: A \(5.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) box rests on a horizontal surface. Find the normal reaction.
A sliding object has \(N=50\,\mathrm{N}\) and \(\mu_k=0.20\). Find the kinetic friction magnitude.
A surface has \(\mu_s=0.40\) and \(N=100\,\mathrm{N}\). Find the maximum static friction.
A box remains at rest while pushed right by \(15\,\mathrm{N}\). What is the static friction force?
questions.answer:
Since the box remains at rest, static friction balances the push:
\[
f_s=15\,\mathrm{N}
\]
It acts to the left.

questions.prompt: A \(10.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) box on a horizontal floor has \(\mu_s=0.30\). A \(25\,\mathrm{N}\) horizontal push is applied. Does the box move?
questions.answer:
\[
f_{s,\max}=\mu_smg=0.30(10.0)(9.8)=29.4\,\mathrm{N}
\]
The \(25\,\mathrm{N}\) push is below the limit, so the box does not move.

questions.prompt: The same \(10.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) box is pushed by \(40\,\mathrm{N}\). If \(\mu_k=0.20\) once it slides, find the kinetic friction magnitude.
A \(4.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) block slides on a horizontal surface with \(\mu_k=0.25\). Find its acceleration due to friction.
questions.answer:
\[
f_k=\mu_kmg
\]
\[
a=-\frac{f_k}{m}=-\mu_kg=-0.25(9.8)=-2.45\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}
\]
The acceleration is opposite the motion.

questions.prompt: A block rests on a \(20^\circ\) incline with \(\mu_s=0.50\). Decide whether static friction can hold it at rest.
questions.answer:
Static friction can hold if
\[
mg\sin20^\circ\le\mu_smg\cos20^\circ
\]
or
\[
\tan20^\circ\le0.50
\]
Since \(\tan20^\circ=0.364\), the block can remain at rest.

questions.prompt: Find the minimum horizontal force needed to start moving a \(12.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) crate on a floor with \(\mu_s=0.45\).
A block slides down a \(30^\circ\) incline with \(\mu_k=0.20\). Find its acceleration along the slope and the normal reaction in terms of \(m\).
questions.answer:
Down the slope is positive:
\[
ma=mg\sin30^\circ-\mu_kmg\cos30^\circ
\]
\[
a=g(\sin30^\circ-\mu_k\cos30^\circ)
\]
\[
a=9.8(0.500-0.20\cos30^\circ)=3.20\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}
\]
Normal reaction:
\[
N=mg\cos30^\circ
\]

questions.prompt: A block is placed on a \(35^\circ\) incline. The coefficients are \(\mu_s=0.40\) and \(\mu_k=0.30\). Decide whether it slips, then find its acceleration if it does. Also find the minimum \(\mu_s\) required to keep it at rest at this angle.
questions.answer:
Check whether static friction can hold:
\[
\tan35^\circ=0.700>0.40
\]
It slips. With kinetic friction,
\[
a=g(\sin35^\circ-\mu_k\cos35^\circ)
\]
\[
a=9.8(\sin35^\circ-0.30\cos35^\circ)=3.21\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}
\]
The acceleration is down the slope.
Minimum static coefficient for rest at \(35^\circ\):
\[
\mu_{s,\min}=\tan35^\circ=0.700
\]

questions.prompt: A \(4.0\,\mathrm{kg}\) crate is pushed horizontally against a vertical wall with \(P=90\,\mathrm N\). Coefficients are \(\mu_s=0.50\), \(\mu_k=0.35\). Determine whether static equilibrium is possible. If not, find the downward acceleration once it slides.
questions.answer:
Normal reaction is set by push:
\[
N=P=90\,\mathrm N
\]
Maximum static friction:
\[
f_{s,\max}=\mu_sN=0.50(90)=45\,\mathrm N
\]
Required for static hold:
\[
mg=4.0(9.8)=39.2\,\mathrm N
\]
Since \(45>39.2\), static equilibrium is possible.
The crate does not slide, so acceleration is
\[
a=0
\]
